name: Olivia Elroy
source: The head priestess leading the convent of the church headquarters. Olivia is the admired leader of the kingdom's priestesses, earning her the nickname of 'Goddess'. She is deeply concerned about the spreading violence arising from the kingdom's war with Astaroth and has gathered the kingdom's priestesses into providing aid and relief to the fighters and victims of the war.
